name: Split Pastel
tagline: A peach and lavender split screen with a graph-paper grid on the right, icon badge pills and rounded black CTA buttons. Adapted from the Split Pastel preset in frontend-slides.

palette.description: a vertical split, peach on the left and lavender with a faint graph-paper grid on the right; near-black type and buttons; mint, yellow and pink badge pills with small dark icon circles

typography.style: one round geometric sans throughout: extra-bold 800 headlines with tight tracking in sentence case, 600 for badges and buttons, 400 for body

best_for: Playful, creative decks: creative reviews, consumer product pitches, workshops, kickoffs, community and family-brand updates. Strong for before/after comparisons (the split is the comparison), big single numbers, simple charts and calls to action.
avoid_for: Formal finance, legal, medical or crisis communication, and dense reading documents. The pastel split, badges and bouncy motion read casual.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
